reviewer: Independent Codex reviewer; no game or asset edits
score_scope: Repository publication rubric. The small visual improvements are verified but do not automatically increase the previous overall score. Not a commercial art parity percentage or a child satisfaction score.

score_rationale.curriculum: 6학년 비례배분을 총원 보존과 좌우 배치로 수행한다. 기존 교육 목표와 문항 구조는 동일하다.
score_rationale.math: 기존 수학 SHA와 핵심 상태 함수 불변, 최종 QA 한국어 문항 111개 독립 정수 재계산 일치.
score_rationale.fun: 배분→양쪽 진격과 오답 후 직접 수정이 작동한다. 자동 전투·문항 반복이라는 기존 한계도 남는다.
score_rationale.visual: 기존 3D 스타일을 보존하며 재질 연결과 작은 환경 세부가 개선됐다. 반복 모델과 단순한 그림자·캐릭터 형태 등 남은 차이를 고려해 기존 17/20을 유지한다.
score_rationale.mobile: 제작자 320/390/820/1280 증거, 부모 390 및 320×720 실제 입력, 독립 390 오답 복구가 통과했다. 실 저가 모바일 성능은 확인하지 않았다.

strengths: 기존 3D 경기장을 유지하며 다리 철띠·못, 젖은 수로 가장자리, 낮은 잎 군락과 자연스러운 잔디를 보강했다.
수학·채점·저장을 보존하고 실제 오답 후 배치를 직접 고쳐 성공하는 흐름을 확인했다.

qualitative_visual_comparison.verdict: verified subtle improvement; existing style retained
improvements: Large checkerboard grass patches became a quieter continuous lawn with subtle variation; troops and two lanes still separate clearly.
Bridge deck now has thin dark straps, light nail heads, small rail caps and grain lines visible at 390px.
Canal edge has an upper lip and darker wet face, with sparse moss and small curved glints.
Low leaves, flowers and small stones add scale around walls and forts without covering the troop lanes.
Warmer and less intense sunlight reduces some harsh contrast while retaining the existing miniature style.
remaining_gaps: Large outer-wall blocks remain strongly uniform and repeated; tree shadows still have firm edges.
At 90 troops, the 72-soldier lane is a dense helmet grid with limited body silhouette and repeated poses.
Fine wood grain and leaves lose detail at 320px; the useful improvement there is material separation and reduced grass patchiness.

mistake_tolerance.scope: 390px actual touch/button input on tutorial and one ordinary question; one ordinary error followed by direct touch correction. Read-only state/geometry hooks; answers independently derived from visible quantities. No RNG fixture, no full campaign rerun, no claim of maximum-count coverage.
mistake_tolerance.actual_path: 일반 문항 30명 2:3에서 13/17로 오답, 하트2. 손잡이 터치와 한 명 버튼으로 12/18 직접 복구 후 성공. 첫 일반 시도 실패는 0/1로 유지; 누적 130점/제출3회.

firstplay.scope: Only the final frame of each current probe was independently viewed here; parent reports full run metadata. No claim that all frames were independently reviewed or that a naive player/child solved the task.
firstplay.final_frame_observation: 작전1/9, 13/17 배치, 하트2. 오른쪽 부족 설명과 손잡이 안내가 보인다.
firstplay.comprehensible: limited to visible instructions and verified actual input paths; naive self-solve and child comprehension unproven

qa_summary.renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M4, Unspecified Version)

maximum_count_scope: Current builder seed4 with test-hook setup for first three operations; real slider/deploy successfully renders and resolves 90 troops (72/18) in the target round. Independently viewed max90 march screenshot. This is not a full normal campaign.
inherited_only: Previous v2 actual one-error nine-operation completion and earlier normal/failure/bot suites; unchanged math and13 state functions. No new full nine-operation campaign claimed here.
limitations: No observed child usability or satisfaction study.
Apple M4 GPU measurements do not establish low-end Android/iOS performance.
Runtime scenery polish retains existing GLB models; downloadable source includes the new runtime files.
Firstplay remained on the tutorial; visible instructions and successful controlled inputs do not prove naive discovery.

At 90 troops, the 72-soldier lane is a dense helmet grid with limited body silhouette and repeated poses.
